about.title: Bellflower Product Liability Claims
about.longDescription: A faulty product doesn't announce itself. In Bellflower, it might be a space heater in a Woodruff Avenue apartment, a power tool from a hardware run down Alondra Boulevard, or a tire that gives out on Bellflower Boulevard during the Friday evening rush. When something you bought or used the way it was meant to be used hurts you, California law gives you a different footing than most injury claims. Under strict liability, you generally don't have to prove the manufacturer was careless. You need to show the product had a defect — in its design, in how that particular unit was made, or in the warnings that came with it — and that the defect caused your injury. Responsibility can reach beyond the maker to the distributor and the store that sold it. LawProactive is not a law firm. We're a free service that connects Bellflower residents with an independent attorney who handles product cases on contingency. Los Angeles County courts hear these claims regularly; you don't have to sort out the first step alone.

whyChoose.title: Why Bellflower Residents Use LawProactive for Product Claims

items.title: Strict Liability Changes the Question
items.desc: You usually don't have to show the maker was negligent — only that the product was defective and the defect caused your injury. The attorney we connect you with can explain how that standard applies to your situation.

items.title: The Product Is Your Evidence
items.desc: Keep the item, its packaging, receipts, and any photos, and don't send it back to the manufacturer. Preserving it is often the single most important thing you can do early on.

items.title: More Than One Party May Answer
items.desc: Manufacturers, distributors, and the retailer that sold the product can all be held responsible under California law. An independent attorney can help identify everyone in that chain.

items.question: My airbag didn't deploy in a crash on Clark Avenue. Is that a product liability case or a car accident case?
items.answer: It can be both, and the two claims can move forward together. Bellflower recorded 357 injury collisions in 2025, and when a safety component fails during one of them, the injured person may have a defect claim against the manufacturer alongside any claim against another driver. Keep the vehicle from being scrapped or repaired until an attorney has reviewed it.

items.question: Do I have to prove the company knew the product was unsafe?
items.answer: Generally no. California product liability often runs on strict liability, which means the focus is on whether the product was defective in its design, manufacture, or warnings and whether that defect caused your injury. The maker's knowledge or carefulness is usually not the deciding issue.
